audit_scope: 2021 base game first printing; Law October 20, 2020; corresponding complete Playbook; official base-game errata updated November 15, 2022; complete multiplayer, Chronicle, and later-game setup. Clockwork Prince and New Foundations excluded.
independence_statement: Independent source-only audit. Read only the assigned candidate, complete allowed extracted Law and Playbook, allowed errata, allowed source PDFs for hashing, and allowed source-render diagrams. Did not read banks, questions, keys, readers, grades, other audits, history, or summary-change files. Candidate was not edited. No external sources or other auditor conclusions were used.

complete_text_delivery.note: A normalized partial errata read was superseded by a complete byte-decoded CRLF-preserving delivery, with exact canonical ranges 0–5000 and 5000–8284.
